title: Universal IR
summary: Universal IR remote for TV, AC and more, using the Mi Home code database
description:
Turns the CardputerZero into a universal infrared remote, following the same pairing flow as the Mi Home app: pick a device type, pick a brand, fire the power key of a code set until the appliance reacts, and control it.

- Framebuffer native: draws straight to /dev/fb0, no browser or compositor, about 6% CPU when idle.
- Brand search by pinyin initials: type xm for Xiaomi or md for Midea instead of scrolling 1800+ brands; hot brands for the current device type are pinned on top.
- Stateful AC control: power, temperature, mode and fan speed go out as one complete state frame, the way Mi Home does it.
- Trial then keep: the last working remote is cached and restored on the next launch, so a configured remote keeps working offline.
- Keyboard first: the eight cells map to the eight letter keys on the device, and F/X/Z/C double as arrow keys.

The code data comes from Xiaomi's own IR database and is cached on disk. Nothing is uploaded anywhere.

zh-CN.title: 万能红外遥控
zh-CN.summary: 用小米码库把 CardputerZero 变成万能红外遥控器，支持电视、空调等
zh-CN.description:
把 CardputerZero 变成万能红外遥控器，配遥控的流程和米家一致：选设备类型 → 选品牌 → 试发电源键选中方案组 → 遥控。

- 原生渲染：直写 /dev/fb0，不经过浏览器或合成器，静态页约 6% CPU
- 拼音首字母搜品牌：打 xm 找小米、md 找美的，不用在 1800+ 个品牌里翻
- 空调状态型控制：电源/温度/模式/风速合成一帧完整状态发出去，和米家一致
- 试发即记：配好的遥控器落盘缓存，断网也能继续用
- 键盘优先：八个格子对应键盘上印的八个字母键，F/X/Z/C 兼作方向键

码数据来自小米自己的红外码库，本地缓存，不上传任何内容。
